item.title: Trump tries to rename AI 'super intelligence' as polls show him sinking on key issue
item.description: Trump shrugged when asked if he is concerned that his support for AI and data centers could hurt Republicans in the upcoming midterm election.

item.title: The Fed's main inflation measure will be released Wednesday. Here's what to expect
